edits:
- "crates/noon-runtime/**"
      - "scripts/playground-playback-morph-regression.mjs"
          npm install --no-save --ignore-scripts playwright@1.62.1 pngjs@7.0.0
      - name: Verify morph endpoints and holds against source playback
        run: |
          node scripts/playground-playback-morph-regression.mjs
          NOON_MORPH_BACKEND=webgpu NOON_MORPH_REGRESSION_ARTIFACTS=browser-smoke-artifacts/playground-playback-morph-webgpu node scripts/playground-playback-morph-regression.mjs
            browser-smoke-artifacts/playground-playback-morph
            browser-smoke-artifacts/playground-playback-morph-webgpu

time: Number(document.querySelector(".playback-controls")?.dataset.elapsedSeconds ?? 0),
        scrubberHidden: document.querySelector(".playback-scrubber")?.hidden,
      .every((sample) => sample.hasControls && sample.controllable === "false" && sample.scrubberDisabled && sample.scrubberHidden),
    "live elapsed time must advance without a misleading percentage during the first Python-owned pass");
